🛡️ NSS IITP App - The Ultimate Admin Guide (v1.1.7)

📅 1. Comprehensive Event Management

As an admin, the Events tab is your main control center. Here is exactly how to navigate it.

1.1 Creating a New Event

  • Step 1: Open the app. At the very bottom of the screen, tap the clipboard icon labeled Events.
  • Step 2: Look in the bottom right corner of the screen. You will see a floating circular button with a + icon. Tap it.
  • Step 3: A "Create Event" form will open. Tap on the Event Title text box and type the name.
  • Step 4: Tap the Date & Time fields. Select the exact start time of your event.
  • Step 5: Enter the Positive Hours (e.g., type 2.0) in the text box.
  • Step 8 (Mandatory Events): Check the box labeled "Mandatory Event". Type the Negative Hours penalty (e.g., 2.0).
  • Step 9: Tap the blue Submit button at the bottom.

1.2 Running an Event (Making it Live)

  • Step 1: Go to the Events tab. You will see your newly created event as a card.
  • Step 2: Tap the green Start Attendance button.
  • Step 3 (If QR Mode): A large QR code will instantly appear on your screen. Hold your phone up!
  • Step 4: Watch the "Live Count" number on your screen go up as students successfully scan.

1.3 Manually Adding / Deleting Attendance

If a student's phone dies or the QR scanner fails, you can manually mark them present or absent using the purple button. This button has two hidden modes!

  • Mode 1 (Add Attendance): Give the purple Add/Delete Roll No button a normal tap. The "Add Manual Attendance" dialog will open. Entering roll numbers here will instantly mark them present!
  • Mode 2 (Mark Absent): Press and HOLD (Long Press) the purple Add/Delete Roll No button for 2 seconds. The "Mark Students Absent" dialog will open. Entering roll numbers here will strictly mark them absent.

1.4 Closing an Event

  • Step 1: When the event is over, tap the red Close Event button.
  • Step 2: The event will move to the History tab.

1.5 Managing Pending Photos (Geo-Tagged Photo mode)

  • Step 1: Go to the Events tab. At the top of the screen, tap Pending Photos.
  • Step 2: Review the selfies and check the GPS location tag.
  • Step 3: Tap ✔ Approve or ✖ Reject.

⚖️ 2. The Penalty System (Negative Hours)

If you made an event "Mandatory", you MUST apply penalties to the absentees after the event closes.

2.1 Applying Penalties

  • Step 1: Tap the yellow Apply Penalty button on the event card.
  • Step 2: A large popup window will open with a list of all absentees. You can filter and bulk-set hours!
  • Step 3: Check the final breakdown before confirming. The math is fully automated.
  • Step 4: Once applied, the event will safely display a greyed-out Penalty Applied button.

🛠️ 3. Fixing Mistakes (Editing & Reopening)

Mistakes happen! You can edit any event hours or even reopen a closed event.

3.1 Reopening a Closed Event (Make Live)

If you accidentally closed an event too early, you can instantly make it Live again.

  • Step 1: Go to the Profile tab in the bottom right corner of the app.
  • Step 2: Scroll down and tap on the Event History button.
  • Step 3: Find your closed event in the list.
  • Step 4: Tap the green ▶ Make Live button directly on the event card. The event will instantly move back to the active Events tab!

3.2 Editing an Event

Did you accidentally type 2 hours instead of 4 hours? You can easily edit any Active event.

  • Step 1: Navigate to the main Events tab (the clipboard icon). Note: You can ONLY edit events from this tab. If the event is closed, follow the steps above to "Make Live" first.
  • Step 2: Press and HOLD (Long Press) your finger anywhere on the entire event card for 2 seconds.
  • Step 3: This will trigger the Edit Event screen.
  • Step 4: Change the Positive Hours text box (or any other field) to the correct value.
  • Step 5: Tap Save. The cloud servers will instantly calculate the math and fix the hours for every attendee.

💬 4. Group Chats & Communication

If you are managing the Teaching and Technical Wing, the app reads the "Subject Assignments" spreadsheet and automatically creates WhatsApp-style groups for every time slot.

To manually create a group, tap the Chats tab, tap the + (New Group) icon, select students, and tap Create.

🆘 5. Resolving Student Issues (Help Portal)

Students will use the app to submit support tickets if their hours are wrong or if they want to apply for leave.

  • Step 1: Tap the Profile tab, scroll down, and tap on Help & Support.
  • Step 2: You will see a list of tickets in the Admin Issue Portal.
  • Step 3: Tap on any ticket to read the message and tap images to view them full-screen.
  • Step 4: Type your reply (e.g., "I have fixed your hours!"), hit send, and tap the green Resolve button to close the ticket.
